name: Trading Market
definition: Context or geographic environment in which trading parties may meet in order to negotiate and execute trades among themselves. It also identifies the primary market where an asset is issued.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Nature of a market in which transactions take place.

ListingDate.name: Listing Date
ListingDate.definition: Date/time at which the security is listed at the specific exchange.

DefaultCurrency.name: Default Currency
DefaultCurrency.definition: Default currency for the securities trading on this market.

FirstTradingDate.name: First Trading Date
FirstTradingDate.definition: First date/time at which the security is eligible for trading.

LastTradingDate.name: Last Trading Date
LastTradingDate.definition: Last date/time at which the security is eligible for trading.

TradedSecurity.name: Traded Security
TradedSecurity.definition: Security which is traded on a specific market.

ListedSecurity.name: Listed Security
ListedSecurity.definition: Security whch is listed on a specific market.

SourceOfPrice.name: Source Of Price
SourceOfPrice.definition: Party which provides a price on a market.

TradeLotSize.name: Trade Lot Size
TradeLotSize.definition: Specifies the number of securities that have to be traded in one lot .

MinimumTradedNominalQuantity.name: Minimum Traded Nominal Quantity
MinimumTradedNominalQuantity.definition: Minimum number of securities that can be traded.

RelatedOrder.name: Related Order
RelatedOrder.definition: Order for which a place of trade is requested.

MaximumTradedNominalQuantity.name: Maximum Traded Nominal Quantity
MaximumTradedNominalQuantity.definition: Miaximum number of securities that can be traded.

StockExchange.name: Stock Exchange
StockExchange.definition: Stock exchange which operates on a specific market.

QuoteLot.name: Quote Lot
QuoteLot.definition: Lot size associated with the price. Most exchanges require that pricing be quoted in round lot size. However, some exchanges have pricing quoted in many different lot sizes, for example, Latin America, some Asian markets, Turkey.

RoundLot.name: Round Lot
RoundLot.definition: Minimum quantity of securities that can be purchased without incurring a larger fee. For example, if the round lot size is 100 and the trade is for 125  shares, then 100 will be processed without a fee and the remaining 25 will incur a service fee for being an odd lot size.

TradingSession.name: Trading Session
TradingSession.definition: Trading session associated with a market.

ListedSecurityTradingIdentification.name: Listed Security Trading Identification
ListedSecurityTradingIdentification.definition: Trading identification used on this trading market.

Issuance.name: Issuance
Issuance.definition: Issuance for which the place has been defined.

RelatedPlaceOfSettlement.name: Related Place Of Settlement
RelatedPlaceOfSettlement.definition: Place of settlement for which a settlement market is specified.
